changes.newText: When an item you upload — with the Upload button or by drag-and-drop — has the same name as an item already in the current directory, the Overwrite Confirmation dialog opens before the transfer starts. A folder is matched by its top-level folder name, not by the individual files inside it.
changes.newHtml: When an item you upload — with the Upload button or by drag-and-drop — has the same name as an item already in the current directory, the Overwrite Confirmation dialog opens before the transfer starts. A folder is matched by its top-level folder name, not by the individual files inside it.

changes.newText: Each conflicting item appears as one row, showing its Name together with the size and modification time of the Existing item and of the Uploading one. Every row is selected by default: keep a row selected to overwrite that item, or clear it to keep the existing item and skip that upload. Click Upload to start the transfer.

changes.newText: Items in the same upload whose names are not already taken are uploaded regardless of the selection, and the dialog reports how many of them there are below the table.
